summary: Nineteen dispatch attack vectors and five additional probes were attempted against harness.DR-G22.platform-abi-loader.v2. All were refuted by measurement. The subject's sha256 matches the expected digest, mode is 0444, and it did not move during review. All 22 recordedInputs digests recompute exactly against live bytes. Top-level head, recordedInputs.HEAD, and live git HEAD are all 01b4dab. The live DR-G22 gate row and every quoted cell are byte-exact against file 08 line 358, and the four-member live-cell split round-trips losslessly back to the live cell string under the document's own delimiter rule — proving no member was dropped, collapsed, or invented. Both naming-v6 executes limbs are witnessed with no extras; executes and doesNotClaim are byte-identical to gate-harness-naming.v6 gates[21]. The leftoverDesign true-sets recomputed from g22-leftover-join.v3 ([OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING]) and platform-tcb-leftover-join.v6 ([OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-RESERVED-TABLES]) are set-identical to what the subject carries, attributed to the correct lineages; OBL-RESERVED-TABLES is left on DR-126 and not stolen. whatThisCloses.leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is empty — the subject claims no new leftover-design closure at all. The INPUT basis is g22-input-corpus.v2 as measured by leftover-join.v3, with v1 carried correctly as a superseded REJECT (CLAUDE-G22IC-V1-SF1). A concrete-population probe found zero populated filesystem, libc, or version tokens; every Rosetta mention is a prohibition grounded in D-006, not an invention. TCB v45 is cited and explicitly not applied. No SATISFIED, no QUALIFIED, no Class A, no fixture bytes, no execution, no D-* number, no file 08 edit, no implementation authorization. required-now is 28, conditions 2 (4/32 NOT MET) and 5 (structurally last, NOT MET) are carried accurately. Self-reference is consistently 'This v2'; frozen v1 is held out as historical at HEAD 5d5d778 / required-now 26 — independently confirmed from v1's own bytes — and is explicitly forbidden as a current occupancy. parentReview is the independent review of gate-harness-naming.v6, the accepted D-086 naming successor per D-145, and the leftover-join is explicitly excluded as parent. The filesystem-axis RESERVED posture is honest incompleteness — the live tokens are quoted and retained, the matrix is declared INCOMPLETE on that axis, and no allowlist is invented. 0 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX.
